target_definition: direct sound plus first 50 ms after the detected direct-path arrival, per-RIR
direct_arrival_detection_rule: index of maximum absolute amplitude in the RIR (peak-based rule), applied per microphone channel
taper_rule: 5 ms raised-cosine (Hann) taper applied at the end of the 50 ms window, rather than abrupt truncation, to avoid introducing spectral artifacts from a hard cutoff
alignment_rule: target and processed/baseline signals are cropped to the minimum common length, both starting at sample 0 relative to the same source convolution; a cross-correlation check is logged (not used to shift) as a sanity check on residual misalignment
gain_normalization_rule: all signals (target, baseline, processed output) are peak-normalized to 0.95 before scoring, for consistency across conditions; note that SI-SDR is scale-invariant by construction and STOI applies its own internal short-term normalization, so this step primarily aids reproducibility and listening comparisons rather than changing metric values
clean_speech_usage: clean speech is used only to construct the target signal and is never provided as input to WPE
